explanation: Subtract a selected jug’s low/high volume bounds from the target interval. A jug fitting entirely inside the remaining requirement completes a feasible selection. Memoize infeasible remainder intervals to avoid repeated searches.
timeComplexity: O(mS) expected time for m jugs and S explored remainder intervals.
spaceComplexity: O(S+H/a) space for failed states and recursion, with smallest positive lower bound a and target upper bound H.
